title: A prompt injection is stopped by the gateway
goal: {{castBrand}} wants {{castApp}} to refuse an attempt to override its instructions while it is {{castTask}}.
obstacle: A user pastes text that tells the model to ignore its instructions and reveal its system prompt. The model alone would simply read it.
control: The inspector reports a prompt injection finding and the key is enforcing, so the gateway answers with its own named refusal. The model is never called and no tokens are spent.
